screening_recipe.note: Early screening used the standalone outputs/ck_tile_attention_probe.cpp precursor. These flags reproduce the same template instantiations with the tracked C++ source; raw scratch timings exclude bias packing and reuse output storage. The canonical backend run is the promotion operator evidence.

remote.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 FIREPROT_RUN_HIP_TESTS=1 PYTHONPATH=.:Protenix python -m pytest -q tests

limitations: One exact protein input, shape, dtype and architecture; no larger-length or Base-model generalization.
The forward baseline fluctuated. A numerical run on GPU 7 overlapped part of the forward comparison on GPU 6. GPU 7 was idle during the primary reverse-order comparison.
Five-sample p95 equals that run's maximum. A CK model slow sample of 13.103 seconds is retained; its stage medians do not justify dismissing it.
Worker wall time includes startup, warmup and multiple predictions; it is not a single-request cold latency.
The experimental-coordinate accuracy of this performance-only sequence is unmeasured. Numerical comparison establishes native agreement.
Initial standalone compile attempts failed on a missing epilogue include and the pipeline's fixed K-prefetch requirement; the final source includes the epilogue and uses K16.
